items.title: Add optional verification:{command,selector} to VerificationIntentItem and pin it immutably on the first evidence write
items.context: packages/main/src/core/types.ts:203-212 (VerificationIntentItem; precedent plannedPathDeclarations:211). The pair is not required at PLAN (intent frozen from DEV, impl absent at PLAN); pin on the FIRST verification_evidence_add for that intentRef, refuse any later write that changes it. selector = test id / case name / assertion string that MUST appear in captured output; command = executable + argv, not a raw shell program.

happy.desc: verification:{command,selector} is on VerificationIntentItem; the first evidence write for an intentRef pins it onto the intent and it round-trips through read/write

edge.desc: a legacy intent/evidence with no pinned verification loads and reads without throwing (grandfathered)

adversarial.desc: a second evidence write that changes the pinned command or selector is refused (pin immutable), while a second write with the same command re-executes

items.title: Make verification_evidence_add execute the pinned command for automated intents and refuse on mismatch
items.context: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:888 verification_evidence_add AND :947 verification_evidence_batch_add (parallel entry point with the same defect — BOTH must reach the same enforcement boundary). VerificationIntentType is logic|cli|browser|manual|docs; the command-executable set is logic|cli|browser. For those, stop trusting caller command+result; run the pinned command via packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts executeValidationPlan (spawn:394) and refuse when (a) exit!=0 but pass claimed, (b) selector absent from output, (c) intentRef does not resolve to an intent on the item (today silently accepted), (d) pinned command != command to run (receipt-command-mismatch: expected X, got Y from done-required-validation.ts:701).

happy.desc: for an executable intent (logic|cli|browser) verification_evidence_add runs the pinned command via the shared enforce-and-stamp helper and writes a receipt when exit==0 and the selector is present

edge.desc: verification_evidence_batch_add enforces identically through the same shared helper: a selector-absent row is refused through the batch path too

adversarial.desc: the write is refused on each of exit!=0-but-pass-claimed, selector-absent-from-output, intentRef-not-resolving-to-an-intent-on-the-item, and pinned-command != command-to-run (receipt-command-mismatch)

items.title: Store a tool-owned receipt (exitCode + outputDigest + outputTail) on the evidence
items.context: Model on packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:892-895 (exitCode/outputDigest=sha256(output)/outputTail helper:531). Reviewers must see real numbers, killing the claimed-N-actually-M counting errors; the receipt is the tool's proof, not the agent's prose.

happy.desc: stored evidence for an executable intent carries a receipt (exitCode + outputDigest + outputTail) and the result field is derived from the actual exit code, not the caller

edge.desc: outputDigest == sha256(captured output) and outputTail is bounded to the tail of the output

adversarial.desc: a caller-supplied result:pass that contradicts a nonzero exit does not survive — the receipt result overrides the claim

items.title: Keep manual|docs intents attestation-only, explicitly non-mechanical, and not scored equal to tool receipts
items.context: type manual|docs cannot auto-execute. Mark them non-mechanical human attestation and ensure the coverage/gate does NOT treat them as equivalent to an executed receipt, so type:manual cannot become an escape hatch that bypasses execution for an automatable intent.

items.title: Grandfather existing prose-only intents and provide an explicit, attributable escape path
items.context: Do not hard-break in-flight stories that already have prose-only evidence without a pinned (command,selector). Provide grandfathering / an audited repair path / a policy mode; emergency overrides must be explicit, attributable, and visible to gates. Per CLAUDE.md handler convention, re-validate every new constraint at Zod + handler entry + consuming gate, and test the internal-call path that bypasses Zod.

items.title: Add a RED-first smoke proving the mechanism and register it in validate
items.context: RED first: an evidence row whose selector is absent from output must be REFUSED after the fix and (demonstrably) was accepted before. Cover BOTH verification_evidence_add and verification_evidence_batch_add: selector-absent refused; intentRef-not-resolving refused; pinned-command-mismatch refused; exit!=0-but-pass refused; happy path (selector present, exit 0) writes a receipt with real exitCode/outputDigest/outputTail; pin immutability (second write changing command/selector refused); manual intent stays attestation-only and is not scored as a receipt. Register under packages/main/src/tasks and lattice.config.json validate.commands + package.json.
